title: 第十二章 异界有房一族
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
唯一可惜的是，这任务每天只能完成一次，也就是说，他每天最多只能增加一年寿命，和游戏里的消费水平比起来，这点收入实在是毛毛雨。
但，要放在现实中看，这个任务可就厉害了：每天只需要工作一小时，就能多出一年寿命，这是多少人抢破头都想要的能力！
有了这个任务，接下来沐游只要不在游戏中继续作死，他的寿命就会源源不断的增多，不但能够达到永生，多余出来的寿命，还可以在游戏中兑换成魔法道具和能力。
回过神来，沐游果断点击了‘加载皮肤’。
一阵滚烫的感觉骤然从全身传来，仿佛有无数小虫子在身周噬咬一般，体内的骨骼和肌肉也都迅速膨胀起来。
沐游双眼充血，忍着灼烧感低头看去。
他的视角明显变高了一些，双手双脚变得修长而有力，流线型的肌肉线条，宛如钢丝一样绞在一起，结实的附着在四肢之上。
而腹部原本并不明显的八块腹肌，以肉眼可见的速度变得棱角分明，就连身上的衣服，也悄然变成了一件宽大的暗红色布衣，此外肩上还莫名多出了一条深色围巾。
转换在眨眼之间便已完成，灼热感迅速消退了下去。
待一切平静下来之后，沐游走到镜子前看了眼。
出乎他意料的是，出现在镜中的是一个完全陌生的面孔。
苍白的肤色，血红色的瞳仁，脖子上缠绕的围巾，遮住了口鼻以下的面容，但那股生人勿进的气势，依然从冷峻的双目之中不断透露而出。
“更换皮肤以后，就连面容和体型都会变化？”
沐游有些意外，低头看着身上覆盖的暗红色布衣。
原本他的身高也就刚到一米八，但现在的他，至少有一米九五，而且体型也肉眼可见的壮实了很多。
“简直是由内到外完全换了一个人啊！”
沐游新奇的看着镜子中陌生的面孔。
不过这样倒也不错，这皮肤可是隐藏身份的绝佳道具！以后他不方便露面的事，都可以换上这个皮肤再去做了。
沐游满意的点点头。
此时游戏中又弹出了新的文本。

【愚者，恭喜你首次更换了新皮肤，从此你将完全代替星灵界的打更人而存在，现在，请为你的新身份取一个名字。】
沐游看的脸色古怪，合着他之前的角色一直没有名字？
不过想想也对，作为被放逐之人，偷渡进入这个世界的愚者，确实是不配获得名字。
只有在获得一件‘皮肤’，鸠占鹊巢掉某个原住民的身份之后，他们才能拥有取名的权利。
【请输入你的新名字。注：该名称需限制在七个字符以内，且不得与原皮肤名相同，不得与其他人重复，名称一经确认，终生无法修改。】
“取名么……”
沐游点开下方的输入框。
既然职业是打更人，他本来准备随手起个‘锦衣夜行’或者‘天黑请闭眼’之类的ID。
但仔细一想又觉得不对，这种名字一看就知道是玩家取的名，以后万一碰到别的玩家，岂不是单从名字上就会暴露自己的玩家身份？
所以这里的取名，还是应该尽量和这个世界的取名风格相似，至少要让人一眼看不出到底是NPC还是玩家。
思考片刻，沐游输入了‘点灯人’。
好在这个ID并没有被占用。
【确认完毕，你获得唯一名称‘点灯人’，并成功开启了角色面板。】
“还有面板？”
沐游一怔。
此时在方形的游戏屏幕右上方，出现了一个‘角色面板’的字样。
点击‘角色面板’。
下方立即弹出一列数据。
【角色面板。
名称：点灯人。

身份：见习巫师。
称号：无。
当前等级：1级。
属性——
力量：1.2（力量影响膂力、负重、物理伤害）
敏捷：1.1（敏捷影响移动速度、攻击速度、闪避能力、动态视力）
智力：1.4（智力影响精神力、咒语威力、施法速度、精神恢复力）
体质：0.9（体质影响生命力、防御力、生命恢复力、异常状态抗性）
生命力：90
精神力：140
剩余寿命：55年。
已习得咒语：百发百中LV1，捕兽陷阱LV1，动物对话LV2。
已拥有皮肤：打更人。
已获得道具：时光怀表，打更人的南瓜灯，老旧的魔杖，打更背包。】
一目了然的属性面板，力敏智体的属性系统，和很多常见游戏类似。
从数值上看，正常成年人的属性应该都是以‘1.0’为标准，他的前三项都要高于平均水平，只有体质稍弱了些。
至于下方的生命力和精神力，明显是直接与体质和智力属性挂钩，数值刚好都是这两项的一百倍。
再下方的三个咒语，前两个都是LV1，只有动物对话达到了LV2，难道是因为他昨天多次释放动物对话的原因？
这时游戏中又弹出了新的文本。
【检测到你已成功继承打更人身份，将自动继承打更人留下的房屋。】

【打更人的木屋：一个可以遮风避雨的住处，同时也是一个复活点。在小屋附近死亡后，将自动从屋内复活。身处木屋内时，可消耗一点行动力，让角色进入‘冥想’状态，期间角色在游戏中无法行动，但精神力恢复速度提升十倍。】
【作为房屋的主人，你掌控了门口的‘魔法南瓜锁’，现在，你可以消耗一点行动力，修改房屋的开启时间和开门暗号，是否立即修改？】
沐游眼睛一亮，又一个惊喜！
替换了身份后，居然连房子也直接归入了他名下。
这波稻草人的情报，‘买’的还真是值啊！
至于房门密码，这个肯定是要改的，毕竟原来的密码已经被稻草人知道了，鬼知道它什么时候会把情报卖给别人。
沐游直接将暗号系统关闭，除了他本人可以刷脸进入外，其他任何人都无法通过暗号进入这个房间。
【魔法南瓜锁设置完成。行动力-1，今日剩余行动力：1/5。】
所有设置搞定，沐游满意的点了点头，这下他也算‘异界有房一族’了，再加上获得了全新的身份，沐游现在对这游戏的期待感更加十足。
今天的行动力还剩下最后一点，他刚准备操控角色再出门探索一下。
结果门口忽然响起了敲门声。
“老板，你在里面吗？”
content_en:
The only pity is that this task can only be completed once a day, which means that he can only add one year to his life every day. Compared with the consumption level in the game, this income is really drizzle.
However, if you look at it in reality, this task is amazing: you only need to work one hour a day to live an extra year. This is an ability that many people want!
With this mission, as long as Mu You does not continue to seek death in the game, his lifespan will continue to increase. Not only can he achieve immortality, but the extra lifespan can also be exchanged for magic items and abilities in the game.
After coming back to his senses, Mu You decisively clicked 'Load Skin'.
A hot feeling suddenly spread through the whole body, as if countless small insects were biting around the body, and the bones and muscles in the body also expanded rapidly.
Mu You's eyes were bloodshot, and he endured the burning sensation and looked down.
His angle of view has obviously become higher, his hands and feet have become slender and powerful, and the streamlined muscle lines are twisted together like steel wires, firmly attached to the limbs.
The originally unobvious eight-pack abs on his abdomen became sharp and angular at a speed visible to the naked eye. Even the clothes on his body quietly turned into a large dark red cloth, and there was an inexplicable dark scarf on his shoulders.
The transformation was completed in the blink of an eye, and the burning sensation quickly subsided.
After everything calmed down, Mu You walked to the mirror and took a look.
To his surprise, what appeared in the mirror was a completely unfamiliar face.
His pale complexion, blood-red pupils, and the scarf wrapped around his neck covered his face below his mouth and nose, but the aura of keeping strangers away was still constantly revealed from his cold eyes.
"After changing the skin, even the face and body shape will change?"
Mu You was a little surprised and looked down at the dark red cloth covering his body.
Originally, his height was only 1.8 meters, but now he is at least 1.95 meters, and his body shape is also much stronger visible to the naked eye.
"You are like a completely different person from the inside out!"
Mu You looked at the unfamiliar face in the mirror with curiosity.
But that’s not bad, this skin is an excellent tool for hiding your identity! In the future, if it is inconvenient for him to show up, he can do it in this skin.
Mu You nodded with satisfaction.
At this time, new text popped up in the game.
[Fool, congratulations on your new skin for the first time. From now on, you will completely replace the watchman in the star spirit world. Now, please give your new identity a name. 】
Mu You had a strange look on his face. His previous character never had a name?
But it's right to think about it. As an exiled person, the Fool who sneaked into this world is indeed not worthy of a name.
Only after obtaining a 'skin' and taking over the identity of an aboriginal can they have the right to name it.
[Please enter your new name. Note: The name must be limited to seven characters, and must not be the same as the original skin name, or repeated with others. Once the name is confirmed, it cannot be modified for life. 】
"What about a name..."
Muyou clicked on the input box below.
Since his job was to be a watchman, he was originally going to randomly create an ID like "Jinyi Night Walk" or "Please close your eyes when it gets dark".
But when I think about it more carefully, I feel that something is wrong. With such a name, I can tell at a glance that it is the name given by a player. If I meet other players in the future, wouldn't my name alone reveal my identity as a player?
Therefore, the naming here should be as similar as possible to the naming style of this world. At least it should not be able to tell whether it is an NPC or a player at a glance.
After thinking for a moment, Mu You entered ‘Lamplighter’.
Fortunately, this ID is not occupied.
[After confirmation, you have obtained the unique name ‘Lamplighter’ and successfully opened the character panel. 】
“And the panel?"
Mu You was startled.
At this time, the words 'Character Panel' appeared on the upper right side of the square game screen.
Click on ‘Character Panel’.
A column of data pops up immediately below.
[Character panel.
Name: Lamplighter.
Identity: Trainee wizard.
Title: None.
Current level: Level 1.
Properties -
Strength: 1.2 (Strength affects physical strength, weight bearing, and physical damage)
Agility: 1.1 (Agility affects movement speed, attack speed, dodge ability, and dynamic vision)
Intelligence: 1.4 (Intelligence affects mental power, spell power, casting speed, and mental recovery)
Physique: 0.9 (Physique affects vitality, defense, life recovery, and abnormal status resistance)
Vitality: 90
Mental strength: 140
Remaining life: 55 years.
Spells learned: LV1 for always hitting the target, LV1 for animal traps, LV2 for animal dialogue.
Already have skin: Watcher.
Props obtained: time pocket watch, clock watcher's jack-o'-lantern, old magic wand, clock watch backpack. 】
The attribute panel is clear at a glance and the attribute system of the force-sensitive intelligence is similar to many common games.
From a numerical point of view, the attributes of a normal adult should be based on '1.0'. His first three items are all above average, and only his physique is slightly weaker.
As for the vitality and mental power below, they are obviously directly linked to the physical and intellectual attributes, and the values ​​are exactly one hundred times of these two items.
Of the three spells below, the first two are all LV1, and only Animal Dialogue has reached LV2. Is it because he released Animal Dialogue multiple times yesterday?
At this time, new text popped up in the game.
[It is detected that you have successfully inherited the identity of the watcher, and you will automatically inherit the house left by the watcher. 】
[The watchman's wooden house: a shelter from the wind and rain, but also a resurrection point. If you die near the hut, you will be automatically resurrected from the hut. When you are in the wooden house, you can consume a little mobility to put the character into a 'meditation' state. During this period, the character cannot move in the game, but the recovery speed of mental power is increased ten times. 】
[As the owner of the house, you control the 'Magic Pumpkin Lock' at the door. Now, you can use a little action to modify the opening time and password of the house. Do you want to modify it immediately? 】
Mu You's eyes lit up, another surprise!
After changing his identity, even the house was directly under his name.
This wave of scarecrow information is really worth the ‘buy’!
As for the door password, this must be changed. After all, the original password has been known to the Scarecrow. Who knows when it will sell the information to others.
Mu You directly turned off the password system. Except for himself, who could enter by swiping his face, no one else could enter the room through the password.
[The magic pumpkin lock setting is completed. Mobility -1, remaining mobility today: 1/5. 】
After all the settings were done, Mu You nodded with satisfaction. Now he could be considered as a 'house owner in another world'. In addition, with the new identity, Mu You was now even more excited about the game.
He still had the last bit of mobility left today, and he was just about to control the character and go out to explore.
As a result, there was a knock on the door suddenly.
"Boss, are you in there? "
